items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: I pulled him out of the band to come to the coast with me... Hal went and rejoined them

ctx.x: Right. That was '45. I never saw her again but about six weeks later I got a call from the head of the studio, who said Betty felt pretty badly about things but she couldn't bring herself to come back on the lot and face me, so would I please leave so that their star could come back to the lot in comfort. And without her, in those days, Paramount was up a creek. She was bringing in all the money, she was their big star. That was it, she had a change of heart and couldn't face me. That took me away from Paramount…
Hal McKusick was living with me at the time--
By into town, you mean back in L.A.?
